approach_logistics.trailheadDirection: From Newhalem, drive SR-20 east about 14 miles; the trailhead parking is on the right between mileposts 134 and 135.

pins.name: Ross Dam Trailhead (SR 20, MP 134)
pins.directions: From I-5 Exit 230 at Burlington, follow SR 20, the North Cascades Highway, east through Marblemount and past Diablo to the Ross Dam Trailhead parking area near milepost 134, about 28 miles beyond Marblemount. Any overnight stay requires a North Cascades National Park backcountry permit, reserved in advance or picked up at the Marblemount Wilderness Information Center.
